title: Unreal Engine projection of ant-hive-world — timelapse 3D rendering of harvested turns on the orwell host
source: operator direction 2026-08-04T21:19Z: 'timelapse is fine but i want it in unreal'
description: Build an Unreal Engine visualization on the orwell host (RTX 5070 Ti) that consumes the harvested, sanitized ant-hive-world projection (world-state, build ledger with spatial coordinates, resource positions, mirror-detector statistics) and renders the hive world in 3D, advancing turn-over-turn in a timelapse cadence driven by short Orwell turns. Strictly a read-only projection consumer: no channel into the sealed VM, no membrane change, no golden change.

overlap_disposition.stated_reason: The owning plan is mid-execution on a high-risk operator-gate lane and scoped to the Orwell deployment/turn contract. This work shares only the harvested-projection DATA surface, none of the mutation surface. Grafting an Unreal build onto a nearly-complete deployment plan would balloon its scope. Interface point (turn cadence + harvest manifest) is bound explicitly in S0.

similarity_assessment.disposition: no credible framework match; gap plan authored from scratch. The prior plan's external_skill_disposition already recorded 'no Unreal or simulation-runtime skill installed' as a known gap.

precedents: _dev/reports/analysis/run-debrief__ant-hive-world-spatial-geometry-mirror-detector__20260803.md — spatial geometry (build coords) now present in the projection
tools/ant-hive-world/dashboard.js — existing 2D consumer of the same projection
tools/fleet/orwell-submind.js + fleet-hosts.json — orwell host access patterns (ssh, RTX 5070 Ti)
hard_constraints: Read-only projection consumer: input is ONLY the harvested out/ projection that already crossed the courier after guest shutdown
No channel into a running guest; no VM config, golden image, seed, or courier contract change
Unreal runs on the orwell HOST (or renders exported turn data), never inside the guest
Timelapse = short-turn cadence (approx 100-250 ticks/turn) using the EXISTING run-job turn mode; cadence is parameterization, not contract change

steps.title: Cadence + projection interface contract
steps.description: Define the short-turn timelapse loop (run-job -Mode turn -Ticks <100-250> repeated, harvest each turn) and freeze an UnrealImport/1.0 JSON schema derived from the harvested projection: per-turn world snapshot (territory, builds with coords, resources, hive population summaries, mirror statistic), turn id + absolute-day provenance on every file. No new data crosses the courier that does not already cross it.

steps.title: Projection importer
steps.description: Node converter: harvested out/ -> UnrealImport/1.0 per-turn files in a watch directory on the orwell host (pushed via existing ssh path or generated host-side from pulled results). Deterministic, schema-validated, idempotent per turn id.

steps.title: Unreal project scaffold on orwell host
steps.description: UE5 project on orwell (RTX 5070 Ti): data-driven level that spawns/updates actors from UnrealImport files — territory tiles, build meshes appearing at their recorded coords, resource markers, a HUD panel for turn id/absolute day/mirror p-value. Turn-advance + auto-advance (timelapse) modes. OPERATOR GATE before installing Unreal Engine on orwell (new heavyweight host software).

steps.title: Timelapse consumption wiring (importer-only — REVISED per codex review 20260804T212131Z)
steps.description: Unreal consumes ONLY named, immutable post-turn harvest manifests (HARVEST-MANIFEST.txt-verified directories under the staging-out root). A watch on the import directory advances the scene when a new verified turn lands. This plan does NOT invoke run-job, harvest, or CANCEL surfaces — turn/harvest/cancellation orchestration and the short-turn timelapse cadence remain owned by ant-world-orwell-live-dashboard; the cadence parameter is recorded there. Producer contract bound in S0: turn_id, absolute_day, run id, payload hash, and boundary receipt fields are explicit, with provenance receipts checked before a turn is rendered.

steps.title: Verify + review binding + debrief
steps.description: Evidence: schema-validation receipts for importer output, a recorded multi-turn timelapse session (screen capture or turn-sequence screenshots), zero-NIC/membrane checks unchanged before and after, distinct-family review of the full slice bound to exact commits, run debrief.

required_gates.decision: Operator approves the FULL enumerated host footprint before S2 begins (codex finding: an install gate must enumerate adjacent actions): Unreal Engine 5.x + Epic Games Launcher (or source build), VC++ redistributables/DirectX prerequisites, estimated 60-120 GB disk on D:, the D:\UnrealProjects\AntWorldProjection project dir, any node/watch service used by S3, and all file transfers to orwell. Rollback: uninstall UE + launcher, delete project dir and watch service. No VM, seed, golden, or courier surface is touched by any of it.

expected_outcomes: A 3D Unreal scene on the orwell desktop showing the hive world building itself turn-over-turn in timelapse
UnrealImport/1.0 schema + importer producing deterministic per-turn files from harvested projections
Membrane unchanged: zero-NIC, courier-only I/O, post-turn projections only
risk_notes: Unreal install is a large host-side mutation on a fleet machine — gated, reversible by uninstall, but disk/driver footprint is real
Timelapse cadence multiplies turn count; watchdog and golden-revert surfaces must behave identically at higher frequency

Escalation triggers: ANY proposed change to VM config, seed, golden, courier contract, or any live channel into a running guest -> stop, operator + destination review (same triggers as the owning plan)
bounded_plan.hardening_opportunity: If the importer+watch-loop shape proves out, the same UnrealImport schema can serve other sims (crow-world, future worlds) — candidate for reusable-template-extractor AFTER >=3 verified runs, not before.

routing_expectations.review_lane_rationale: Cross-surface (repo tooling + orwell host software) and fleet-host-touching, but no client data, no credentials beyond existing ssh, no VM/membrane mutation. The Unreal install itself is operator-gated inside the plan (G-ORWELL-UNREAL-INSTALL).
escalation_triggers: any VM config, seed, golden, or courier contract change
any channel into a running guest (live streaming from the sim)
any credential beyond the existing orwell ssh path

operator_gates.decision: Approve Unreal Engine install on orwell host
